hard_constraints: Use Legends EU continuity: post-Fate of the Jedi (47 ABY), Ben Skywalker as Jedi Knight under Grand Master Luke Skywalker on Coruscant.
Terminology: datapad (not laptop/tablet), comm protocols (not radio/phone), Steady Returns as modified YT-series freighter.
Single Ben Skywalker close-third POV; no head-hopping.
No in-universe use of 'Legends' or 'Canon'; no ABY/BBY dates spoken.
Force described experientially, not scientifically; no 'energy field'.
canon_risks: Ben assuming field command without consulting Luke risks contradicting post-Fate Jedi protocols if drafter assumes rigid hierarchy; project canonizes Luke sending Ben alone (Ch1-2), making independent action baseline.
Group dynamics with ancient survivors (Sera, Torin, Kael) must preserve NSW-era ranks/voices without modernizing (e.g., Torin as 'Battle Master Hal', Sera archaic syntax).
legends_continuity_notes: Ben's GAG service under Jacen Solo (Legacy of the Force) bonds him/Desh; shared shame surfaces in pressure moments.
Luke's field Jedi protocols (Fate of the Jedi): regular check-ins expected but flexible for solo missions; blank template fits pattern of structured omission (Ch3-7).
Jedi mission reports: standardized holonet/datapad templates for field Knights (post-NJO norms); mission-state field tracks operational summary/status.
YT-series freighters (common Legends civilian craft): cramped common areas suit tactical reconfigs.
Corridor/anchor nodes: AU but grounded in Ruusan Reformations/NSW wounds (Darth Bane trilogy, Jedi vs. Sith).
required_context_for_drafter: Setting: Steady Returns common area as tactical briefing; Desh's displays show Corridor map/intercept route.
Characters: Ben (commander), Sera (shifts to 'Skywalker' with investment), Torin (warm approval), Kael (arms-crossed evaluator), Desh (notes blank template).
Key beats: Ben names Veraine 'engineering' (not studying), array-dependency forces Veranthos intercept; Sera posture shift (spine straightens); Luke template blank/visible.
Sera voice: Archaic, formal (no early contractions); 'Skywalker' marks conditional trust/Gavran echo.
Torin warmth load-bearing: Approval reassuring but off (per project notes).
Emotional arc: Assumed authority -> naming lands -> Sera trust/test -> blank template cost.
No Force mechanics here: Tactical/dialogue-led; keep concrete (maps, routes).
allowed_au_divergences: Veraine as Brotherhood alchemist/escaped anchor engineering amplification array.
Seal/wound at Veranthos; Ruusan Reformations as penance/cover-up.
